'''Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac''' was a brand of [[Alcohol/Legends|wine]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was popular with members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the debate over a [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|military budget bill]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], consumed during meetings, small conferences, and celebrations. The wine became the focal point of an investigation into the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], as the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] was killed by [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that had been mixed into his serving of Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac.

==Description==
Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac was produced on the<ref name="Ep. Guide" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Ep. Guide" /> The purple-colored wine was sold in a tall, narrow bottle adorned with several stickers, the largest of which displayed the brand name and the phrase "Produce of Naboo"<ref name="Ep. Guide" /> in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]],<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> as well as an artistic rendering of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]],<ref name="Ep. Guide" /> the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] retreat of Naboo's [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]].<ref name="AotC VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:AToast-SM.png|thumb|left|200px|Senators Amidala, Farr and Mothma enjoying Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], a member of the Naberrie family,<ref name="AotC VD" /> shared a bottle of Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac with fellow senators [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]] in celebration of her well-received address to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] regarding proposed [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|legislation]] that would reduce the Republic's military budget. Before the senators drank from the bottle, however, it was seized by intruding [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]]. Farr ushered Burtoni out of the meeting, and the senators resumed their celebration and consumed the Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac. Unfortunately for the senators in the celebration, the wine had been mixed with a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that was engineered on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be [[Rodian-lethal poison|lethal]] exclusively to [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] to which Farr and Purs belonged. Farr [[Death/Legends|died]] as a result of drinking the Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac, while Purs had elected not to consume the beverage, and so survived.<ref name="SM" />

Burtoni and her colleague, the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]], also enjoyed a bottle of Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac during a meeting in [[Deechi's office/Legends|Deechi's office]]. Burtoni was initially accused of poisoning Farr's wine when she seized his bottle, due to her opposition to the Rodian and the origin of the poison. However, it was later revealed that Senator Purs was the culprit&mdash;a fact that was only discovered when Amidala realized the younger Rodian had chosen not to drink from the Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac.<ref name="SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac was first seen in "[[Senate Murders]]," the fifteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. While the brand name on the bottle of the wine consumed in the episode is too small to see on-screen, the name Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac was revealed in the trivia section of "Senate Murder"'s [http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode215.html online episode guide]. Translated to [[Wikipedia:French language|French]], ''Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac'' means "Domain of the House on the Lake."<ref name="translation">{{WebCite|url=http://webtranslation.paralink.com|text=Translation|work=WebTranslation.com|archivedate=20111007020413}}</ref>
